every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 hides the left-hand card during camera transitions in frames 4 and 7 so the Anchor Rack is never obscured, whereas Site 2 keeps the card visible in frame 4 and covers almost the entire 3D rack.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory metaphor across frames 1 to 9, showing raw log slabs in frame 3 compressed by a digest press in frame 5 and routed to an anchor rack and seven host lanes in frames 6 and 8.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites render the identical 3D machinery, dark grid floor, edge highlights, and contact shadows across all nine frames.

type_and_layout.reason: While both share the same typography and card design, Site 1 times its card visibility so frame 4 gives the 3D scene breathing room instead of colliding with the left machine like Site 2's frame 4.

overall.reason: Both sites share the same strong visual metaphor and 3D scene, but Site 1 handles scroll transitions cleaner by hiding text cards during camera moves so the 3D subject isn't covered up as seen in frame 4.
